skill.name: grammar-and-style-enhancer
skill.description: Improves text quality by enhancing grammar, vocabulary, narrative clarity, flow, pacing, and writing style while preserving the author’s voice.
skill.summary: Edits grammar, clarity, flow, pacing, and style while preserving the author's voice and intent.
skill.author: Amraha-Anwar

content.user_title: Improve Grammar, Clarity, and Writing Style
content.value_statement: Drafts often contain grammar errors, repetition, uneven pacing, or unclear transitions. This skill revises text for clarity, flow, and style while preserving meaning and voice.
actual_capabilities: Corrects grammar, punctuation, and sentence structure.
Improves word choice and reduces repetition.
Strengthens flow, readability, and paragraph cohesion.
Adjusts emotional tone, imagery, dialogue, pacing, and rhythm.
Preserves meaning, character voice, and narrative intent.
Returns an improved version, change summary, and style suggestions.
limitations: Requires the source text, preferred tone, and editing level for a tailored result.
Does not verify facts, citations, originality, or legal accuracy.
Cannot guarantee that every stylistic choice matches the author's preferences.
Heavier rewrites require careful review to confirm voice and intent remain intact.

use_cases.title: Refine Academic Drafts
use_cases.description: Improve grammar, paragraph cohesion, and readability while preserving the student's original argument.

use_cases.title: Polish Workplace Writing
use_cases.description: Revise emails, reports, and updates for a clear, consistent, and professional tone.

use_cases.title: Strengthen Fiction Scenes
use_cases.description: Improve dialogue, imagery, pacing, and emotional tone without replacing character voice or narrative intent.

prompt_templates.title: Correct Basic Errors
prompt_templates.prompt:
Correct the grammar and punctuation in this text using a light edit. Preserve my wording and return the improved version with a brief change summary.

[Text]
prompt_templates.scenario: Quick proofreading with minimal stylistic changes

prompt_templates.title: Polish a Professional Email
prompt_templates.prompt:
Revise this email in a formal tone using a medium edit. Improve clarity, sentence structure, and word choice without changing its meaning.

[Email]

prompt_templates.title: Enhance a Fiction Scene
prompt_templates.prompt:
Edit this fiction scene in a dramatic tone using a medium edit. Improve dialogue, pacing, imagery, and paragraph cohesion while preserving each character's voice.

[Scene]
prompt_templates.scenario: Creative writing that needs stronger flow and atmosphere

prompt_templates.title: Run a Multi-Layer Chapter Edit
prompt_templates.prompt:
Perform a heavy, multi-layer edit of this chapter. Strengthen grammar, readability, emotional tone, rhythm, and cohesion while preserving narrative intent. Provide the improved chapter, a change summary, and focused style suggestions.

[Chapter]
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced revision across language, structure, and narrative style

output_examples.input: The team have finished the report, but it still need a clearer conclusion.
output_examples.output:
The team has finished the report, but it still needs a clearer conclusion.

Change summary: Corrected subject-verb agreement and retained the original meaning.

output_examples.input: "I do not know," she said nervous. The room was silent and it felt scary.
output_examples.output:
"I do not know," she said nervously. The silent room tightened around her.

Change summary: Corrected the adverb and strengthened the atmosphere while preserving the scene's intent.

best_practices: State the intended audience, tone, and editing level before sharing the text.
Review the improved version against the original meaning and voice.
Request focused changes when dialogue, pacing, or imagery matters most.
anti_patterns: Do not request a heavy rewrite when exact wording must remain unchanged.
Do not accept stylistic changes without checking facts, quotations, and specialized terminology.
Do not omit tone or audience requirements when they affect the desired result.

faq.question: What does this skill improve?
faq.answer: It improves grammar, punctuation, sentence structure, word choice, flow, cohesion, voice consistency, pacing, and rhythm.

faq.question: Can it preserve my writing voice?
faq.answer: Yes. It is instructed to preserve meaning, character voice, and narrative intent during revision.

faq.question: Which editing levels can I request?
faq.answer: You can request a light, medium, or heavy edit based on how much revision you need.

faq.question: Can it edit fiction?
faq.answer: Yes. It can improve dialogue, imagery, emotional tone, pacing, and rhythm in fiction.

faq.question: What output will I receive?
faq.answer: You will receive an improved version, a change summary, and suggestions for further stylistic improvement.

faq.question: Does it check facts or citations?
faq.answer: No. Review factual claims, citations, quotations, and specialized terminology separately.
